econ-rcb-2025.label: RCB bowling economy, 2025
econ-rcb-2025.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ dismissals (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
econ-rcb-2025.filters: Runs charged to bowlers ÷ legal balls × 6, regulation innings
econ-rcb-2025.query: SELECT SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2025 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15)

top-bat-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ dismissals (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
top-bat-name.query: SELECT p.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2025 GROUP BY d.batter_id ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 3

top-bowl-name.label: RCB's leading wicket-taker, 2025
top-bowl-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches ⨝ innings ⨝ deliveries ⨝ dismissals (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
top-bowl-name.query: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) wkts FROM dismissals dm JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = dm.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2025 AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id ORDER BY wkts DESC LIMIT 3

validation.method: rank by wickets from dismissals table (not fact_bowling_spells, which credits retired out)
